text:
maria: Hey team — quick smoke request from customer LynxField. They shipped a LoRA patch (lf-lora-v2) and are seeing tokenization/formatting oddities on amounts after int4 quant. Can someone run a compatibility + int4 smoke eval against our hosted int4 profile? Patch id: lf-lora-v2-2026-03-20

aj: on it. do we have the seed prompts or a tiny evalpack? :mag_right:

maria: Short set is fine for now — 30 examples. Pasting the 3 that flagged them: 
- Total due: $1,234.56
- Invoice: 1.234,56 €
- Amount: ¥1200
They reported token splits and rounding regressions after we merged the adapter locally.

zack: I'll run a quick smoke on phoenix-rt with quant=int4 and compare base->merged. ETA ~8m.

eval-bot: queued eval job e-1749876543-01 on runner-3. estimated 6m.

zack: running command I used:
```
# quick smoke run
redwood eval run --model rdx-base-3b --adapter lf-lora-v2 --quant int4 --tasks currency-format --samples 30 --out /tmp/lf-smoke.json
```

zack: initial summary: PPL(base)=12.4, PPL(merged)=13.1 (delta +5.6%). Token diffs: 3/30 examples with boundary changes (comma <-> dot), and 1/30 where "1,234" tokenized as ["1", ",", "234"] after merge.

devon: sounds like the adapter learned locale-specific token pieces. do we know which tokenizer config the customer trained with? maybe they used a locale-aware preproc.

aj: re-ran with tokenizer_v2 flag (use tokenizers/tokenizer_v2) and same eval: PPL(merged)=12.7, delta +2.4%. Token diffs now 1/30 (still the euro example).

zack: attaching tiny diff snippet (merged vs base token ids):
```
example 2: "Invoice: 1.234,56 €"
base tokens: [Invoice, :, 1.234, ,, 56, €]
merged tokens: [Invoice, :, 1.234, ,, 56, €, <UNK>]?  <-- subtle trailing tokenization shift
```

maria: Good find. Action items: 1) ask customer for their tokenizer recipe and any locale-normalization used; 2) recommend they try training adapter with tokenizer_v2 or we can include a tokenizer remap during merging; 3) add the three failing examples to the onboarding regression suite.

devon: I'll draft a small tokenizer remap patch we can test: normalize_thousands = [",", "."] -> unify to "," for the euro case, or add locale tag token to adapter input.

aj: FYI, re-run with remap reduced diffs to 0/30 in a quick smoke (local). I'll push the temp config to gists: https://gist.github.com/temp/lf-token-remap

maria: Perfect. I'll open a proper onboarding ticket for LynxField and include the eval outputs + suggested fixes. Will ask SE to get the original training recipe from the customer.

maria: cc @product-evangelist for visibility :eyes:

aj: will follow up once we have the customer's tokenizer and the full evalpack.

zack: marking this smoke as "investigate -> resolved?pending-customer" for now.

maria: thanks all :heart:
